INV-HX-2026-07-02 | Helionix | Promo: PROMO-HX40 | -4,800.00 | promo_id:PROMO-HX40

omar: that's clearly double-applied. This is a billing correction. Post as contra-revenue. Suggest: DEBIT 4-2112 Promo Contra $4,800; CREDIT 1-1100 AR $4,800. Tag HEL-007.
suzanne-finance: agree. Finance pre-approves pending partner sign-off. For <10k Partnerships sign-off is enough.
partners: Helionix ops replied: "Confirmed — duplicate promo from our side; authorize reversal and accept debit memo." Will attach their ack.
jules: billing-bot, create reversal case and provisional credit.
billing-bot: Action: created reversal_case RC-74321 amount 4800 status:pending_memo_sign. Customer notifications suppressed.
